correctness.rationale: The six distinct 3x3 permutation matrices span the stochastic affine space with one linear dependence: choosing c0=t solves c=(t,d01−d22+t,d02−d11+t,d00−t,d22−t,d11−t). Nonnegativity iff max(0,d22−d01,d11−d02)<=t<=min(d00,d11,d22); Birkhoff existence supplies nonempty interval. All six coordinates are strictly positive for L<t<U and at least one vanishes at each endpoint, so minimum support is min(endpoint supports) and at most two optima. If all D entries lie in (1/Q)Z, both t endpoints and six weights do too. Sharp five-term 1/13 matrix has five positive terms at both ends. Independent enumerator checked all 839 matrices for Q<=6 and exactly reconstructed every endpoint; finite checks are not an all-real proof.
